name: Arroyomolinos (Madrid, Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arroyomolinos (a tower and millwheels on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Arroyomolinos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arroyomolinos arms — tower and millwheels on red above waves
tower, millwheels and crown of the arms
